title: Feeling TipSea Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Feeling TipSea is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Feeling TipSea is the guest home of Knotty By Nature which is available to rent separately by other guests, or in combination if you need more space as Knotty By Nature and Feeling TipSea.Welcome to Feeling TipSea – A Newly Renovated Seaside RetreatJust six homes from the beach and only two blocks from the heart of Seaside and the iconic Seaside Amphitheater, Feeling TipSea is a beautifully renovated guest home designed for effortless coastal living. Freshly updated from top to bottom, this charming retreat blends modern luxury with classic Seaside charm—perfect for couples or small families seeking both comfort and proximity to everything Seaside has to offer.Bright, Coastal Living SpacesStep inside to discover a light-filled interior wrapped in crisp white beadboard and outfitted with designer furnishings throughout. The inviting living area features a queen sleeper sofa, a cozy dining nook for two, and a sleek wall-mounted Smart TV with a Sonos soundbar—ideal for relaxing after a sun-soaked day. Recessed lighting and thoughtful coastal details create a warm, welcoming atmosphere throughout the home.Chef-Quality Kitchen with Premium FinishesThe fully renovated kitchen sits just off the living space and is outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, including a full-size Wolf oven, Wolf gas range, and Wolf microwave. Custom cabinetry, marble countertops, generous storage, and a large farmhouse sink elevate the space, making it as functional as it is beautiful. A convenient half bath is also located on the main level.Private King Suite with Juliette BalconyUpstairs, the serene primary suite offers a true retreat. Featuring a king bed, vaulted white oak ceilings, a modern ceiling fan, and a flat-screen Smart TV, this space is filled with natural light and peaceful charm. Step out onto your private Juliette balcony to enjoy treetop views and gentle coastal breezes. The ensuite bathroom has been fully renovated and includes a glass-enclosed rain shower and single vanity for a spa-like experience.An Ideal Seaside EscapeWith its prime location near the beach and town center, fresh modern upgrades, and thoughtful design throughout, Feeling TipSea offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Whether you’re strolling to the shoreline, enjoying live music at the amphitheater, or unwinding in your private retreat, this charming guest home promises a memorable Seaside stay.(Please be aware there is a private plunge pool adjacent to the guest home that can be in use by the main home, Knotty By Nature. Pool Access comes with the main home Knotty by Nature only, not available for the guest home Feeling TipSea.). Queen sleeper sofa operating instructions: Locate the lower section of the sofa base and firmly pull it outward until fully extended. Lift and pop it up into place until it locks flush with the sofa, forming a flat, queen-size sleeping surface.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESApproximately 496 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach access at Savannah Pavilion351 feet or a 2-minute walk to beach accessFully equipped kitchenSub-Zero refrigerator (panel finish)Wolf gas range and Wolf microwave oven comboBosch dishwasher (panel finish)Smart TV with Sonos soundbarBuilt-in closets for streamlined storagePeacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels, sheets, and coverlets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking policy: One parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.STR23-001868
